Class GeneratedQueryParser

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.runtime.query.GeneratedQueryParser
@Internal public final class GeneratedQueryParser extends Object
Parses the SQL-shaped query string that reaches the Nitrite runtime when a query was not built as a Nitrite JSON filter, for example an update declared through @Query in JPQL form.

Predicates are translated to the module's native field filters where possible. Computed comparisons such as LOWER(name) = LOWER(:p1), LENGTH(name) = :p1, and field-to-field comparisons are routed through the module's expression evaluator. Anything else is rejected with a message naming the offending fragment, so an unsupported query fails loudly instead of silently matching or updating the wrong documents.

Since:
5.2.0

  • Method Details

    • parseWhere

      @Nullable public @Nullable org.dizitart.no2.filters.Filter parseWhere(String query, io.micronaut.data.model.runtime.RuntimePersistentEntity<?> entity, Object[] params)
      Parses the WHERE clause of a generated query.

      Any ORDER BY, GROUP BY or HAVING clause following the predicate is discarded: those are applied through FindOptions by the caller, not through the filter.

      Parameters:
      query - the full query string
      entity - the root entity
      params - the positional parameter values
      Returns:
      the filter, or null when the query carries no WHERE clause

    • parseOrderBy

      @Nullable public static @Nullable io.micronaut.data.model.Sort parseOrderBy(String query)
      Parses the ORDER BY clause of a generated query into a Sort, so a sorted derived finder orders its results even when its query was built as SQL rather than as a Nitrite JSON filter carrying a $sort key.

      Property names are returned as written, minus the query alias; the caller resolves them against the entity when it builds the find options.

      Parameters:
      query - the full query string
      Returns:
      the sort, or null when the query carries no ORDER BY clause

    • parseUpdate

      public Map<String,Object> parseUpdate(String query, io.micronaut.data.model.runtime.RuntimePersistentEntity<?> entity, Object[] params)
      Parses a generated update into the update operators understood by the Nitrite executor. Self-referential arithmetic assignments are retained as increment/multiply operations so their value is computed from each stored document rather than once up front.
      Parameters:
      query - the full update query
      entity - the root entity
      params - the positional parameter values
      Returns:
      update operations keyed by Nitrite operator
